name: scanRBP
description: scanRBP loads RNA-protein binding motif PWM and computes the log-odds scores for all the loaded RBPs across a given genomic sequence + draws a heatmap of the scores.

paragraphs: scanRBP loads RNA-binding protein (RBP) motif position weight matrices (PWMs) and computes log-odds binding scores for every loaded RBP across a given nucleotide sequence, then draws a heatmap of the scores.
No installation needed: you can try scanRBP online, right in your browser, via expressRNA.org — go to Analyses → New Analysis → scanRBP Analysis.
